info.title: Yabane API
info.description: Yabane is a transparent LLM gateway. Inference endpoints proxy OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, and Anthropic Messages to configured upstream providers. OpenAI Responses can explicitly target a ChatGPT Plus/Pro OAuth subscription Endpoint. Control endpoints manage providers, endpoints, upstream credentials, model routes, gateway access, and activity. Every action available in the web console is available here.

post.description: The model field selects routing: provider/model, or a public model route alias. Yabane prefers a native Chat Completions Endpoint and otherwise converts the request and successful response to the configured upstream protocol; conversion is reported in the response header and Activity.

Yabane prefers a native Responses Endpoint and otherwise converts the request and successful response to the configured upstream protocol. ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription Endpoints require stream=true upstream and use the explicitly configured Codex backend adapter.
Yabane prefers a native Anthropic Messages Endpoint and otherwise converts the request and successful response to the configured upstream protocol; native paths remain transparent.

patch.description: Updates any supplied note, expiration, or Provider allowlist field without changing the key secret. Omitted fields remain unchanged; expires_at: null removes expiry and provider_ids: [] grants access to every Provider. Scoped-key validation and persistence are serialized with Provider deletion.

post.description: Starts OpenAI device-code OAuth for a new Provider or a new Endpoint on an existing Provider. When socks5_proxy is set, device authorization, token exchange, refresh, and inference use that proxy. OAuth tokens are never returned by this API.

get.description: Returns pending status or completes OAuth and atomically creates the connected subscription Endpoint.

post.description: Starts pi-ai-compatible Authorization Code with PKCE as an explicit alternative when an organization disables device sign-in. The registered callback is http://localhost:1455/auth/callback; Yabane does not listen there and the administrator pastes the resulting complete callback URL into the completion operation.

Validates the complete pasted localhost callback URL and its state, exchanges its one-time authorization code with the server-held PKCE verifier, and atomically creates the connected subscription Endpoint. Callback URLs, authorization codes, verifier, and OAuth tokens are not returned or persisted as flow history.

post.description: Every target must currently be usable. Validation and persistence are serialized with Provider and Endpoint mutations so a concurrent deletion cannot leave a dangling target. An OpenAI subscription target requires the OpenAI Subscription Extension to be enabled; disabling it later retains the route but makes that target fail visibly until re-enabled.

delete.summary: Delete an API endpoint and its route destinations

patch.description: Updates an Endpoint and its connection settings without exposing or replacing existing API-key secrets or Endpoint request defaults. Changing id atomically updates current discovered-model availability, model Endpoint preferences, model-route destinations, Provider Request Defaults scope, and an inactive Traffic Capture scope; historical Activity and retained captures keep the ID recorded when each request occurred. An active Traffic Capture scoped to the Endpoint must first be stopped. Disabling required authentication atomically clears credential references from model-route targets. Enabling it is rejected while keyless route targets still refer to the Endpoint. OpenAI subscription Endpoints accept ID and SOCKS5 proxy changes only; their API type, base URL, and credential requirement remain fixed.

id.description: The desired unique Endpoint ID. Changing it updates current configuration references.

weights.description: Every enabled key exactly once; integer weights must total 100.
